a system of fast writing that uses signs for sounds and words
a person who writes spoken words in shorthand and transcribes them
equipment that makes many copies of a document at once
items.s: Stenographer: a person who writes spoken words in shorthand and transcribes them. The other options describe Shorthand, Duplicating machine, Word processing.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Capacity to contract?

an agreement between parties that the law will enforce
the legal ability of a person to enter a binding agreement
items.s: Capacity to contract: the legal ability of a person to enter a binding agreement. The other options describe Offer, Acceptance, Contract.
